translations.web: For it is written, “ ‘As I live,’ says the Lord, ‘to me every knee will bow. Every tongue will confess to God.’ ”
translations.bsb: It is written: “As surely as I live, says the Lord, every knee will bow before Me; every tongue will confess to God.”
translations.kjv: For it is written, As I live, saith the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God.
translations.asv: For it is written, As I live, saith the Lord, to me every knee shall bow, And every tongue shall confess to God.
